# Model fixtures

- `geometry/triangle.obj`: original geometry-only OBJ, MIT.
- `solid/triangle.obj` + MTL: original plain-color material fixture, MIT.
- `textured/triangle.obj` + MTL + PNG: original UV/texture fixture, MIT.
- `animated-triangle/AnimatedTriangle.gltf`: CC0 animated triangle by Marco Hutter,
  from Khronos glTF Sample Assets; see its source and license files.
- `vertex-colors/BoxVertexColors.glb`: CC0 vertex-color cube from Khronos glTF
  Sample Assets; see its source and license files.

The original OBJ/MTL and checker texture fixtures use the repository's MIT license.
Third-party files are kept unchanged, with pinned upstream source references.
